# Logistic growth {#sec-logistic}

{{< include ../preamble.qmd >}}

## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}
$$
    \frac{dN}{dt} = r N (1 - \frac{N}{K})
$${#eq-logistic-growth}

## Examples {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Logistic growth trajectories with different parameters"
#| label: fig-logistic-trajectories

# Analytical solution to logistic growth equation
# N(t) = K / (1 + ((K - N0) / N0) * exp(-r * t))

# Time vector
t <- seq(0, 50, length.out = 1000)
N0 <- 1  # Initial population size

# Define four parameter sets
# Default case
r1 <- 0.2
K1 <- 100

# Negative r
r2 <- -0.5
K2 <- 100

# Slightly higher r
r3 <- 0.35
K3 <- 100

# Same r as default, but lower K
r4 <- 0.2
K4 <- 50

# Calculate trajectories using the analytical solution
logistic <- function(t, N0, r, K) {
  K / (1 + ((K - N0) / N0) * exp(-r * t))
}

N1 <- logistic(t, N0, r1, K1)
N2 <- logistic(t, N0, r2, K2)
N3 <- logistic(t, N0, r3, K3)
N4 <- logistic(t, N0, r4, K4)

# Create plot
plot(t, N1, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "blue",
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Population size (N)",
     ylim = c(-5, 110), main = "Logistic Growth Trajectories")
lines(t, N2, lwd = 2, col = "red")
lines(t, N3, lwd = 2, col = "green")
lines(t, N4, lwd = 2, col = "purple")

# Add legend
legend("right",
       c(paste("r =", r1, ", K =", K1, " (default)"),
         paste("r =", r2, ", K =", K2, " (negative r)"),
         paste("r =", r3, ", K =", K3, " (higher r)"),
         paste("r =", r1, ", K =", K4, " (lower K)")),
       col = c("blue", "red", "green", "purple"),
       lwd = 2)

# Add grid
grid()
```

Solving the differential equation numerically using `deSolve`:

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Logistic growth: numerical vs analytical solutions"
#| label: fig-logistic-desolve

library(deSolve)

# Define the logistic growth ODE system
logistic_ode <- function(t, state, params) {
  N <- state
  r <- params["r"]
  K <- params["K"]

  dN_dt <- r * N * (1 - N / K)

  list(dN_dt)
}

# Time vector for numerical solution
times <- seq(0, 50, by = 0.1)
N0 <- 1

# Parameter sets (same as before)
params_list <- list(
  list(r = 0.2, K = 100, name = "default", col = "blue"),
  list(r = -0.5, K = 100, name = "negative r", col = "red"),
  list(r = 0.35, K = 100, name = "higher r", col = "green"),
  list(r = 0.2, K = 50, name = "lower K", col = "purple")
)

# Create plot
plot(NA, NA, xlim = c(0, 50), ylim = c(-5, 110),
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Population size (N)",
     main = "Logistic Growth: Numerical (deSolve) Solutions")

# Solve and plot for each parameter set
for (params in params_list) {
  out <- ode(y = N0, times = times, func = logistic_ode,
             parms = c(r = params$r, K = params$K))

  lines(out[, 1], out[, 2], lwd = 2, col = params$col)
}

# Add legend
legend("right",
       c("r = 0.2, K = 100 (default)",
         "r = -0.15, K = 100 (negative r)",
         "r = 0.35, K = 100 (higher r)",
         "r = 0.2, K = 50 (lower K)"),
       col = c("blue", "red", "green", "purple"),
       lwd = 2)

grid()
```
